tenderAddress.blockNumber: Bangalore Bioinnovation Centre, Helix Biotech Park, IBAB Campus, Electronic City Phase I, Electronic City, Doddathoguru, Karnataka 560100

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the Past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of Tenders

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All criteria must be in compliance with Annexure-1

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Proof of at least two executed fire safety works projects worth 1 crore or more each, between Apr 1, 2022 , Mar 31, 2025
ISI/ISO certification of the supply & installation of network devices. (certified from the notified body) mandatory
Annual Turnover for the last 3 years (Minimum 1 Cr P.A.) audited by CA with P & L and Balance Sheet

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: ISI/ISO certification of the supply & installation of network devices. certified from the notified body mandatory
Karnataka Fire safety department Approved / Certified letter mandatory with validity period.
ROHS, Trademark Registration, CE, QMS, MSME certification needed mandatory
